text.tspan: # Latte art at dawn - Kling 3.0 (8s, 16:9, t2v)

svg.text: A barista in a grey apron, sleeves rolled, steady hands holding a steel milk
jug in an empty cafe at dawn, a wooden counter lit by low sun through the front
window. Kodak 250D look, warm highlights, muted shadows, fine grain. 100mm
macro, f/4, shallow depth of field. Low golden sun as key from camera-right,
soft bounce fill, steam backlit. 0-2s: The milk jug tilts and a thin white
stream hits the brown crema. Camera: locked-off, top-down on the cup. 2-4s:

text.tspan: ... three more beats, then Motion: ... and Audio: ambience, sound effects
morphing, extra limbs, warped hands, flicker, text, watermark, logo, jump cuts
